applications.choose_for: Rasterize the final PDF and extract its actual text for independent review
applications.sources: Original PDF, numbered page PNGs, extracted text and rendering settings
applications.limits: Render the exact delivery hash. PNG creation is not a visual judgment; use an available visual model or request user review. Render in bounded batches.

groups.goal: Rasterize the actual delivered PDF to numbered PNG pages for visual inspection; rendering is not visual approval.
Extract text from the actual PDF, preserving layout where possible; not OCR or visual validation.

applications.choose_for: Check PDF syntax, cross references and recoverability independently of the authoring tool
applications.sources: Original PDF, native diagnostics and verification receipt
applications.limits: A warning is not a clean pass. Syntax checks do not certify layout, accessibility, PDF/A or PDF/X; use veraPDF for applicable conformance profiles.

groups.goal: Check native PDF syntax and cross references. Warnings remain visible; does not certify PDF/A or visual quality.

applications.choose_for: Validate delivered PDFs against an explicitly chosen PDF/A profile
applications.sources: Original PDF, selected profile, complete native XML report and receipt
applications.limits: Never equate PDF/A conformance with accessibility or visual quality. Do not claim a conversion or certification from a validation report.

groups.goal: Validate a PDF against a selected PDF/A profile; save the native XML report and actual conformance status.

applications.choose_for: Add an OCR text layer and text sidecar to scanned PDFs while preserving the original
applications.sources: Original scan, searchable PDF, sidecar, language and OCR recipe
applications.limits: Do not replace original scans. Check names, numbers, reading order and language against sampled images; OCR confidence is not accuracy. This adapter does not claim PDF/A.

groups.goal: Create a searchable PDF and text sidecar without overwriting the scan. OCR accuracy requires content review.

applications.choose_for: Recognize text in local images with coordinates and confidence evidence
applications.sources: Original image, TXT, TSV, language and preprocessing recipe
applications.limits: Use OCRmyPDF for whole scanned PDFs. Keep low-confidence words visible; confidence is not a guarantee. English and Italian language data are installed explicitly.

groups.goal: Recognize a local image into text and TSV with confidence/coordinates; preserve the original image.

applications.choose_for: Inspect raster georeferencing and convert raster datasets to GeoTIFF
applications.sources: Original geospatial datasets, sidecars, CRS, units, transformation recipe and GeoTIFF
applications.limits: Confirm CRS, axis order, units, nodata and extents. Format conversion is not reprojection. Do not invent coordinates; advanced vector workflows use the native ogr tools.

groups.goal: Read native raster metadata, coordinate reference system, bands and extents into JSON.
Convert a raster to GeoTIFF while preserving the original and recording the recipe.

applications.choose_for: Run explicit native Processing algorithms on local geographic data
applications.sources: QGIS projects when authored, input layers/styles, parameter JSON and output layers
applications.limits: A Processing output is not automatically a complete QGIS project. Check CRS, geometry, units and relative dependencies; do not rely on unavailable plugins or external providers.

groups.goal: Run a named QGIS Processing algorithm using an explicit JSON parameter file and copied resources. Outputs must be relative to the private job folder.

applications.choose_for: Exercise authorized test APIs against a saved OpenAPI contract
applications.sources: Original OpenAPI schema, target configuration, native JUnit report and reproducible test parameters
applications.limits: Requests may mutate data. Use an authorized disposable target, bound examples and workers, and preserve failing cases. Passing schema checks do not prove business correctness.

groups.goal: Exercise an explicitly authorized HTTP API from a local OpenAPI schema. Save native JUnit evidence; may create or modify test data.

applications.choose_for: Run explicit small load tests with thresholds and native metric summaries
applications.sources: JavaScript scenario, fixtures, thresholds, target configuration and metric summary
applications.limits: Select test traffic and authorization before running. Bound VUs, iterations and duration. Report actual load and latency percentiles; a local sample is not a production capacity guarantee.

groups.goal: Execute an explicit local load-test script with bounded iterations and virtual users against an authorized test system.

applications.choose_for: Inspect actual browser pages for axe accessibility rules
applications.sources: Page or application sources, audit URL/state, native JSON findings and incomplete checks
applications.limits: Complements Playwright behavior tests. Zero violations does not certify WCAG compliance; keyboard, screen-reader and human review remain necessary.

groups.goal: Run axe-core in real headless Chromium on an authorized page; report violations, incomplete checks and limits.

applications.choose_for: Spider an authorized application and collect passive security findings with an explicit automation plan
applications.sources: Authorization/scope, automation plan, native XML report and reproduction guidance
applications.limits: The adapter contains no activeScan job. Spidering still sends requests and can affect poorly designed applications. Keep target scope narrow, triage findings and distinguish an incomplete scan from no findings.

groups.goal: Run ZAP Quick Start without an active attack against an explicitly authorized URL. Save native XML evidence; passive findings are not a complete penetration test.

applications.choose_for: Scan local source directories for leaked credentials without executing the source
applications.sources: Redacted native findings, scanner identity and remediation guidance; retain original source privately
applications.limits: Do not copy discovered secrets into chat or delivery archives. Redact both logs and reports. A match needs triage; remediation may require credential rotation, not only deleting a line.

groups.goal: Scan a local directory for leaked secrets without executing its code. Native reports are redacted; findings do not imply exploitability.

applications.choose_for: Compile and simulate explicit Modelica models and MOS recipes on CPU
applications.sources: MO models, MOS recipe, parameters, local libraries, units and simulation data
applications.limits: Do not silently download libraries. Use explicit initial conditions and solver settings, check actual simulation success and numerical plausibility. This is not engineering certification.

groups.goal: Execute an explicit MOS recipe in a copied project folder; retain Modelica models, parameters and simulation results.

applications.choose_for: Solve explicit LP and MPS optimization models
applications.sources: LP/MPS model, objective/constraints/units, solver settings, solution and native status
applications.limits: Distinguish optimal, feasible, infeasible, unbounded and time-limited outcomes. Never present an infeasible model or a time-limited incumbent as a proven optimum.

groups.goal: Solve an explicit LP/MPS model with bounded CPU time; retain the model, native solution and log. Interpret feasibility and optimality from the report.

applications.choose_for: Export native electronic schematics and PCBs using headless KiCad CLI
applications.sources: KICAD_PRO, KICAD_SCH, KICAD_PCB and any custom symbol/footprint libraries, plus fabrication exports when requested
applications.limits: SVG is an export, not an editable circuit source. Check ERC/DRC and footprints with native tools for manufacturing work; SVG export alone proves neither electrical correctness nor fabrication readiness.

groups.goal: Export PCB or schematic SVG with native KiCad CLI; preserve native project files and custom libraries.

applications.choose_for: Simulate explicit SPICE netlists and preserve actual raw results
applications.sources: Netlist, included component models, stimuli, analysis settings and raw simulation data
applications.limits: Check model licenses, convergence, units and operating conditions. Simulation does not guarantee physical performance or safety; preserve all local include files.

groups.goal: Run a local SPICE netlist in batch mode, preserving models, netlist and native results.

applications.choose_for: Slice existing models using explicit printer and material settings
applications.sources: Original mesh or 3MF project, printer/material INI, slicing recipe and G-code
applications.limits: Do not replace CAD/mesh authoring tools. G-code is machine-specific; confirm printer, bed, nozzle, temperatures, supports and scale before use. Do not claim a physical print was tested.

groups.goal: Slice a local mesh using an explicit printer/material configuration; preserve model, configuration and G-code. Does not certify printer safety.

applications.choose_for: Use one SQL client across supported relational database drivers for explicit read-only queries.
applications.sources: SQL, bounded result JSON and local database snapshot or external-source requirements.
applications.limits: Validate one SELECT, confirm the real driver and use read-only database credentials. Client driver availability does not prove a remote connection was tested.

groups.goal: Run a validated SELECT with the native universal SQL client. Use a read-only connection; retain SQL and result JSON, never connection secrets.

applications.choose_for: Reverse engineer real keys, constraints, table relationships and schema metadata through JDBC.
applications.sources: Schema JSON/HTML/DOT, database snapshot or connection requirements, diagrams and interpretation notes.
applications.limits: Separate declared constraints from inferred associations and sampled data. Validate business meaning with the owner; do not invent tables or relationships from names. The bundled distribution uses GPL v3 and retains JDBC notices.

groups.goal: Reverse engineer actual database schema, keys, constraints and associations with JDBC. Inferred relations remain hypotheses.

applications.choose_for: Discover SQL/document source metadata and extract bounded data into a reproducible local pipeline.
applications.sources: Python pipeline, schema YAML/JSON, query/inputs, portable JSONL, DuckDB snapshot and row reconciliation.
applications.limits: Separate SQL metadata, sampled document fields and business hypotheses. Keep pipeline state private per job, preserve type/null semantics and reconcile counts. External reads require authorized read-only credentials; no source-system writes are performed.

groups.goal: Inspect SQL metadata with SQLAlchemy or MongoDB collection structure. Produce editable schema JSON; sampling is not complete semantic understanding.
Extract bounded local JSON/CSV or authorized read-only SQL/MongoDB data into a private DuckDB pipeline. Preserve pipeline, schema, receipt and reconciliation.

applications.choose_for: Parse SQL dialects and derive table/column lineage using real expressions and actual supplied schemas.
applications.sources: Original SQL, actual schema dictionary, normalized SQL, lineage JSON and limits.
applications.limits: Parsing does not execute SQL or prove database semantics. Unknown columns, wildcard expansion, dynamic SQL and missing schema remain explicit limits; never invent lineage. Use SchemaCrawler/dlt for live metadata and SQLMesh for executable model plans.

groups.goal: Parse and normalize SQL and derive actual table/column lineage where schema is available; do not invent business meaning or execute SQL.

applications.choose_for: Plan, test and explain SQL/Python analytical transformations using an isolated local DuckDB project.
applications.sources: SQL/Python models, tests, configuration, copied project, DuckDB results and plan/audit evidence.
applications.limits: Explain the actual graph and reconcile known totals. Apply only when apply_local=true, in the isolated copied project. This adapter does not deploy to remote production. Exchange JSONL/CSV/Parquet rather than assuming all DuckDB file versions interoperate.

groups.goal: Validate tests and explain a SQL/Python transformation project in an isolated local DuckDB environment. Apply only with apply_local=true; never auto-apply to a remote database.

applications.choose_for: Check a plain-text journal: parsing, balanced transactions and balance assertions; strict also requires declared accounts and commodities
applications.sources: Journal file, CSV reports and native check output
applications.limits: Reports reflect only the recorded entries; a balanced journal is not an audited account or tax advice.

groups.goal: Check a plain-text journal: parsing, balanced transactions and balance assertions; strict also requires declared accounts and commodities. Errors are reported, never corrected.
Run a native report on a plain-text journal and save CSV; the journal stays the editable source. Totals reflect only the recorded entries.

applications.choose_for: Check a Beancount ledger: syntax, open accounts, balanced postings and balance assertions
applications.sources: Ledger file, BQL query and CSV results
applications.limits: bean-check validates syntax, accounts and assertions; it does not certify accounting or tax correctness.

groups.goal: Check a Beancount ledger: syntax, open accounts, balanced postings and balance assertions. Errors are reported, never corrected.
Run a read-only BQL query on a Beancount ledger and save CSV results.

applications.choose_for: Convert molecules between SMILES, SDF, MOL, MOL2, XYZ, PDB, CML and InChI; optionally generate 3D coordinates
applications.sources: Original molecule file, converted structure and descriptor table
applications.limits: Generated 3D coordinates and descriptors (logP, TPSA) are estimates; they are not validated conformers or measurements.

groups.goal: Convert molecules between SMILES, SDF, MOL, MOL2, XYZ, PDB, CML and InChI; optionally generate 3D coordinates. Generated geometry is a starting point, not a validated conformer.
Compute formula, molecular weight, logP and TPSA per molecule. Descriptors are estimates, not measurements.

applications.choose_for: Optimize a molecular geometry (XYZ) with the GFN2-xTB semiempirical method; save the optimized structure and native log
applications.sources: Input geometry, optimized structure and native log
applications.limits: GFN2-xTB is approximate; confirm critical energies or geometries with higher-level methods before relying on them.

groups.goal: Optimize a molecular geometry (XYZ) with the GFN2-xTB semiempirical method; save the optimized structure and native log. Semiempirical energies are approximate.

applications.choose_for: Summarize FASTA/FASTQ files: counts, lengths, N50, GC and quality fractions as TSV
applications.sources: Original sequences, filtered files and statistics
applications.limits: Statistics describe the files; they do not assess biological quality, contamination or sample identity.

groups.goal: Summarize FASTA/FASTQ files: counts, lengths, N50, GC and quality fractions as TSV.
Keep sequences within a length range, optionally reverse-complemented, into a new FASTA/FASTQ.

applications.choose_for: Count mapped, paired and duplicate reads of a SAM/BAM/CRAM alignment as TSV
applications.sources: Original alignment, sorted BAM with index and flag statistics
applications.limits: Counts depend on the aligner and flags; they are not a variant call or a clinical result.

groups.goal: Count mapped, paired and duplicate reads of a SAM/BAM/CRAM alignment as TSV.
Sort an alignment by coordinate into BAM and build its index.

applications.choose_for: Summarize a VCF/BCF: records, SNPs, indels, transitions/transversions and quality distributions
applications.sources: Original VCF/BCF and native statistics
applications.limits: Variant statistics are descriptive; interpretation, filtering thresholds and clinical meaning need expert review.

groups.goal: Summarize a VCF/BCF: records, SNPs, indels, transitions/transversions and quality distributions.

applications.choose_for: Align reads or assemblies to a reference FASTA into SAM with an explicit preset; alignment is evidence for interpretation, not a variant call
applications.sources: Reads, reference and SAM alignment
applications.limits: Mapping positions depend on preset and reference; alignment is evidence for interpretation, not a variant call.

groups.goal: Align reads or assemblies to a reference FASTA into SAM with an explicit preset; alignment is evidence for interpretation, not a variant call.

applications.choose_for: Build a multiple sequence alignment from FASTA with MAFFT --auto; save the aligned FASTA
applications.sources: Input sequences and aligned FASTA
applications.limits: Automatic strategy selection may not suit every family; inspect gaps and conserved regions before phylogenetic use.

groups.goal: Build a multiple sequence alignment from FASTA with MAFFT --auto; save the aligned FASTA.

applications.choose_for: Check an SMT-LIB 2 problem with the Z3 solver; report sat, unsat or unknown with the model or core it prints
applications.sources: SMT-LIB problem, solver answer and model
applications.limits: unknown or a timeout is not a proof; a model satisfies the encoded constraints only, not unstated requirements.

groups.goal: Check an SMT-LIB 2 problem with the Z3 solver; report sat, unsat or unknown with the model or core it prints. unknown is not a proof.

applications.choose_for: Solve a MiniZinc constraint model (optionally with a .dzn data file) using Gecode within a time limit; save every printed solution and the optimality status
applications.sources: Model, data file and printed solutions with status
applications.limits: A time limit may stop before optimality; only ========== marks a proven optimum for the encoded model.

groups.goal: Solve a MiniZinc constraint model (optionally with a .dzn data file) using Gecode within a time limit; save every printed solution and the optimality status.

applications.choose_for: Run a Maxima batch file (symbolic algebra, calculus, equations) and save the transcript
applications.sources: Batch file and transcript
applications.limits: Symbolic results depend on assumptions (domains, signs); check special cases and conditions stated in the transcript.

groups.goal: Run a Maxima batch file (symbolic algebra, calculus, equations) and save the transcript. Check results against the problem statement.

applications.choose_for: Run a PARI/GP script (number theory, exact arithmetic, polynomials) and save its output
applications.sources: GP script and output
applications.limits: Some functions are probabilistic (e.g. ispseudoprime); state which results are proven.

groups.goal: Run a PARI/GP script (number theory, exact arithmetic, polynomials) and save its output.

applications.choose_for: Describe a NetCDF/GRIB dataset: variables, grid, levels and time steps
applications.sources: Original dataset, derived NetCDF and dataset description
applications.limits: Statistics follow the grid and calendar of the data; check units, missing values and grid cell areas before conclusions.

groups.goal: Describe a NetCDF/GRIB dataset: variables, grid, levels and time steps.
Compute a time or field statistic of a NetCDF/GRIB dataset into a new NetCDF file.

applications.choose_for: Print the metadata of a NetCDF file: dimensions, variables, attributes and units
applications.sources: Original NetCDF, metadata listing and subset file
applications.limits: Metadata reflects what the producer wrote; units and conventions still need checking against CF rules.

groups.goal: Print the metadata of a NetCDF file: dimensions, variables, attributes and units.
Extract selected variables of a NetCDF file into a new file.

applications.choose_for: Read embedded metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP, GPS, document properties) of a file into grouped JSON, without changing it
applications.sources: Original file untouched and grouped metadata JSON
applications.limits: Listing metadata does not remove it; personal data may also be visible in the content itself.

groups.goal: Read embedded metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP, GPS, document properties) of a file into grouped JSON, without changing it.

applications.choose_for: List the metadata mat2 would remove from a document, image or media file
applications.sources: Original file preserved, cleaned copy and removed metadata list
applications.limits: Removes embedded metadata only; faces, text, watermarks or hidden layers in the visible content are not anonymized.

groups.goal: List the metadata mat2 would remove from a document, image or media file.
Write a cleaned copy without metadata; the original is preserved. Visible content (faces, text, watermarks) is not anonymized.

applications.choose_for: List the OpenType tables of a font file with their checksums and sizes
applications.sources: Original font, subset font and table listing
applications.limits: Subsetting must be allowed by the font licence; check rendering of every required language after subsetting.

groups.goal: List the OpenType tables of a font file with their checksums and sizes.
Subset a font to the characters of a given text and save TTF, WOFF or WOFF2; licences must allow subsetting.

applications.choose_for: Open a font (TTF, OTF, SFD, UFO, WOFF) and generate it in another format, reporting the glyph count
applications.sources: Original font, generated font and glyph count
applications.limits: Format conversion keeps outlines but may drop hinting or features; font licences still apply.

groups.goal: Open a font (TTF, OTF, SFD, UFO, WOFF) and generate it in another format, reporting the glyph count. Font licences still apply.

applications.choose_for: Encode data as a barcode or 2D code (QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Code 128, EAN-13, GS1-128) in SVG or PNG; check scannability on the final medium
applications.sources: Encoded data file and SVG/PNG code
applications.limits: Generation is not a scan test; check size, quiet zone and contrast on the final printed medium.

groups.goal: Encode data as a barcode or 2D code (QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Code 128, EAN-13, GS1-128) in SVG or PNG; check scannability on the final medium.

applications.choose_for: Analyze a shell script for bugs and portability issues; save JSON findings
applications.sources: Script and JSON findings
applications.limits: No finding does not prove correctness; behaviour still needs tests on the target shell and system.

groups.goal: Analyze a shell script for bugs and portability issues; save JSON findings. No finding does not prove the script is correct.

applications.choose_for: Lint a Dockerfile against best practices (including ShellCheck on RUN steps); save JSON findings
applications.sources: Dockerfile and JSON findings
applications.limits: Best-practice findings do not prove the image builds or is secure; build and scan it separately.

groups.goal: Lint a Dockerfile against best practices (including ShellCheck on RUN steps); save JSON findings.

applications.choose_for: Check a GitHub Actions workflow: syntax, expressions, job dependencies and embedded scripts; save JSON findings
applications.sources: Workflow file and JSON findings
applications.limits: Static checks cannot prove secrets, permissions or runners behave as intended at run time.

groups.goal: Check a GitHub Actions workflow: syntax, expressions, job dependencies and embedded scripts; save JSON findings.

applications.choose_for: Lint a Terraform module directory with the bundled core rules (no provider plugins downloaded); save JSON findings
applications.sources: Module folder and JSON findings
applications.limits: Only bundled core rules run offline; provider-specific rules and real plans need the provider plugins and credentials.

groups.goal: Lint a Terraform module directory with the bundled core rules (no provider plugins downloaded); save JSON findings.

applications.choose_for: Lint an OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document with the standard Spectral rulesets or a supplied ruleset; save JSON findings
applications.sources: API document, ruleset and JSON findings
applications.limits: A clean lint is not a working API; test the implementation against the contract separately.

groups.goal: Lint an OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document with the standard Spectral rulesets or a supplied ruleset; save JSON findings.

applications.choose_for: Apply a jq filter to JSON and save the result; the filter is kept with the output
applications.sources: Input JSON, filter and result
applications.limits: A filter that runs is not a validated transformation; compare counts and key values with the source.

groups.goal: Apply a jq filter to JSON and save the result; the filter is kept with the output.

applications.choose_for: Apply a jq filter to YAML (or XML/TOML read as YAML) and save YAML output
applications.sources: Input YAML, filter and YAML result
applications.limits: Comments and anchors are not preserved by the jq round trip; keep the original as the editable source.

groups.goal: Apply a jq filter to YAML (or XML/TOML read as YAML) and save YAML output.

applications.choose_for: Convert or transform CSV, TSV or JSON with Miller; an optional DSL script file is kept with the output
applications.sources: Input data, DSL script and converted result
applications.limits: Type inference may change number formats; check separators, encodings and totals against the source.

groups.goal: Convert or transform CSV, TSV or JSON with Miller; an optional DSL script file is kept with the output.

applications.choose_for: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12, 2019-09 or 07) and save all errors
applications.sources: Data, schema and validation errors
applications.limits: Schema validity covers structure and declared formats only, not business rules outside the schema.

groups.goal: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12, 2019-09 or 07) and save all errors.

applications.choose_for: Compile an MJML email template into responsive HTML with strict validation
applications.sources: MJML source and compiled HTML
applications.limits: Compiled HTML still renders differently across email clients; test in the target clients before sending.

groups.goal: Compile an MJML email template into responsive HTML with strict validation. Rendering still differs by email client.

applications.choose_for: Engrave ABC music notation into SVG pages, one per tune
applications.sources: ABC source and SVG score pages
applications.limits: Engraving shows notation only; listen to the MIDI and review layout before publication.

groups.goal: Engrave ABC music notation into SVG pages, one per tune.

applications.choose_for: Convert ABC music notation into a MIDI file for listening checks
applications.sources: ABC source and MIDI file
applications.limits: MIDI playback uses default instruments and tempo; it is a listening check, not a final mix.

groups.goal: Convert ABC music notation into a MIDI file for listening checks.

applications.choose_for: List words not found in the Italian or English Hunspell dictionary; names and technical terms need human review
applications.sources: Text and list of unknown words
applications.limits: Unknown words include names and technical terms; grammar, style and meaning are not checked.

groups.goal: List words not found in the Italian or English Hunspell dictionary; names and technical terms need human review.

applications.choose_for: Check prose against style rules (Vale built-in rules or a supplied .vale.ini with local styles); save JSON alerts
applications.sources: Text, .vale.ini with styles and JSON alerts
applications.limits: Rules check style mechanically; they do not judge content, tone or accuracy.

groups.goal: Check prose against style rules (Vale built-in rules or a supplied .vale.ini with local styles); save JSON alerts.
